name: Civil War II
description: A young Inhuman named Ulysses sees a disaster coming, and the heroes stop it. Carol Danvers wants to act on his next warning before anyone gets hurt. Tony Stark draws the line at treating a vision as proof. Then a vision points to one of their own.
